articles.title: Visuals show scope of widespread flooding in Indiana - USA Today
articles.description: At least seven people have died in Indiana after storms and flooding forced many to evacuate their homes.
articles.content:
At least seven people are dead after flooding in Indiana has caused families to evacuate their homes and forced business owners to close their doors.
Multiple people were rescued as floods continued… [+1390 chars]
